_doc: Pellet boost + cost (Steve 2026-11-08 07:03 CST reframe: the pellet bearer gains basically unlimited food boosts, WITH A COST). The reactor turns stored food into power: staying fed is free, extra power costs pantry calories. Whole-unit pantry draws (Steve 2026-10-08): a boost asks for costKcalPerStrike and pantryDraw takes whole units, so the ledger records the ACTUAL kcal drawn, which can exceed the ask. The free floor (floorMult) is the reactor's steady hum and costs nothing; the paid boost (boostMult) is per strike, bearer only, scholar and villager alike. A paid boost also marks a feast-surge spend (Q4: a surge counts even when the spender can't eat anymore).
note: Bearer-only. Scholar-bearer: the scholar's strikes. Villager-bearer: that villager's strikes. Party members get nothing. The free floor never marks a surge spend (it costs nothing, so it is not a spend).
